messages:
elaine (marketing): quick postmortem from the webinar lead rush: ~1.9k/min for 3m -> observed ~6% handoff fallthrough and 3 duplicate leads in SF.

omar (ops): thanks, any enrichment timeouts in the logs?

elaine (marketing): enrichment callback median 1.1s, 95p at 1.9s. our claim TTL is 1.2s for webhooks. that's the mismatch.

jia (growth): so enrichment slower than TTL -> fallback to default owner. can we avoid default assign for campaign traffic?

rafa (sales-ops): suggestion: campaign-level flag to route to a temporary "campaign-warm" owner instead of default. keeps leads live for SDRs and reduces duplicates.

omar (ops): agree. propose: soft_hold_ms = 300 when queue_depth > 35 and campaign.meta.high_qps = true, else fallback as today. implement warm_owner override and a feature flag for rollout.

elaine (marketing): we'll add campaign.metadata.high_qps on webinar templates and paid ads. also want a dashboard tile for fallthrough % by campaign.

jia (growth): can growth/marketing toggle that flag per event in the UI?

rafa (sales-ops): yes, I'll update the campaign template and SF routing rule: IF campaign.metadata.high_qps = true THEN owner = 'campaign-warm' ELSE normal_rr().

omar (ops): action items: PR to add soft_hold behavior, expose queue_depth metric, add feature flag. I'll tag eng-infra and metrics.

deploy-bot: deploy queued by omar tag: inbound-campaign-warm-176840 - canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%, canary window 15m. health check = fallthrough_rate < 2%

elaine (marketing): thanks — add runbook step: for spikes, enable campaign-warm + increase enrichment_ttl to 1.6s for webhook consumer. logging graphs to the inbound-runbook.
